correctness.rationale: Explicit symplectic block centralizer and square-zero equations reduce to (A,B). Any nonzero skew-adjoint square-zero A has rank two with maximal totally isotropic image, possible only for split four-form. Counting two reguli and nonzero alternating forms gives 2(q²−1) A. Compatible symmetric blocks solve a 6-dimensional linear system; every corresponding X has rank four. The A=0 strata are all symmetric four-by-four rank classes. These arguments prove all coefficients for every odd prime power. Direct enumerations over q=3,5,7 and complete q=3 B fibers and symmetric ranks passed. Risk: standard finite-field form-count and hyperbolic regulus lemmas are required and explicitly stated.

value.rationale: The two rational orbits have identical geometric nilpotent partition (2,2,2,2), but the natural rank-refined square-zero centralizer invariant separates them solely at maximal rank, by a large explicit factor 2(q²−1)q⁶. The proof identifies the geometric obstruction as presence versus absence of maximal isotropic planes in a four-dimensional quadratic multiplicity space. It is a motivated smallest split-Witt obstruction and an exact complete five-stratum enumeration, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
